ops.text: ccx vcs ship on a Sprite (git lane, no GitHub App at /dev/shm/cc-remote/github-app.json) committed and pushed a new branch but opened no PR, and it reported only 'CI unconfirmed: no CI run was registered'. Neither the first ship, the --amend ship nor a --no-commit ship said a PR was missing or why. Only passing --pr-title-file and --pr-body-file explicitly opened yasyf/cc-slack#485. Ship should open the PR from the commit message as its help says, or say why it did not.
